EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Congratulations on Your First Payroll!
Congratulations! Your first payroll has been processed. Now that we’ve achieved that first big milestone together, I would like to acquaint you with some additional information that will be beneficial to you.
Need Help: Click on the hyperlink to navigate to our help page where you can access videos and quick tutorials designed to assist you with:
· Manage your employee’s information such as: compensation, job titles, classification, and processing employee terminations. Just click on an individual employee’s name to start making changes.
· Onboarding new employees: Setting up and managing your new employee paperwork is easy!
As always, please feel free to reach out to me if there is anything else I can help you with.
Thank you for choosing Insperity!
